attribution: These issues were discovered and corrected by the AI assistants during implementation and review. They were not planted and are not evidence of fixes authored by the applicant.

findings.discoveredBy: Assistant integration review against src/server/entries.ts and src/server/media.ts
findings.before: The first journal schema permitted 10,000 note characters while the server accepted 6,000. The initial upload picker also offered GIF, MP3, and WAV files that the server did not accept.
findings.impact: A form could appear valid and only fail after submission or upload, leaving users to discover avoidable validation errors.
findings.fix: Aligned note validation to 6,000 characters and upload choices to JPEG/PNG/WebP images and WebM/Ogg/MP4 audio. Error copy and file-picker accept attributes now match.
findings.status: Corrected during integration, before the affected feature was committed. End-to-end checks follow once the assembled app serves.

findings.before: A recorder error stopped microphone tracks, but a following stop event still uploaded collected partial audio.
findings.impact: The interface could report a recording failure and then present an incomplete clip as an uploaded recording.
findings.fix: Track the failed recording session and discard its stop-event payload while still stopping all microphone tracks.
findings.verification: Regression test reproduced an unexpected upload after the error event; the corrected handler blocks that upload.

findings.discoveredBy: Accessible-role inspection during composer interaction tests
findings.before: Link help text and the live character count were children of wrapping labels, so assistive names included the help text or changing count.
findings.impact: Inputs had unnecessarily long and unstable accessible names.
findings.fix: Give the Link and note fields explicit stable label IDs; associate the help and count separately as descriptions.
findings.verification: The link input is now addressable by its exact accessible name, and the unsafe-link submission test exercises it.
